title: Evaluating Foundation Models with Pathological Concept Learning for Kidney Cancer

bias_targets.methodology: Splitting predicted low- and high-risk patient groups by gender (female and male) and conducting log-rank tests on Kaplan-Meier survival curves to evaluate if the risk identification method performs equally across genders.

Splitting predicted low- and high-risk patient groups by race (white and black) and conducting log-rank tests on Kaplan-Meier survival curves to assess if the risk identification method is unbiased across different racial groups.
